participant_instructions: Answer from the repository at the exact target revision.
Trace the named production entry point and any helpers needed to explain observable control flow, mutations, yielded/returned values, and exceptions.
Support each material claim with an inline citation in the form `relative/path.py:start-end`.
Do not rely on tests, runtime experiments, or prior benchmark answers as a substitute for source reasoning.

tasks.title: Credential preparation pipeline
tasks.prompt: Trace `CredentialManager.get_auth_credential(context)` end to end. Explain how the custom-auth path differs from the ordinary path; every early return and validation failure; the ordered sources from which an ordinary credential is obtained; when the raw credential is deep-copied; how exchange and refresh interact; and the exact conditions under which a credential is persisted. Include the OAuth metadata-discovery behavior only insofar as it is reached by this entrypoint.

tasks.title: Text agent callback and error lifecycle
tasks.prompt: Trace `BaseAgent.run_async(parent_context)` for a text invocation. Explain context creation and instrumentation; plugin-versus-agent callback precedence before and after the core generator; which callback outcomes emit events or terminate the invocation; the ordering and lifecycle of yielded events; and what happens when any stage raises, including whether error-notification failures can replace the original exception.

tasks.title: Sliding-window compaction arbitration
tasks.prompt: Trace `_run_compaction_for_sliding_window(app, session, session_service, skip_token_compaction=...)`. Explain every no-output gate; how rewind filtering affects the input; when token-threshold compaction preempts sliding-window work; how invocation IDs and timestamps determine the sliding range and overlap; how the candidate event slice is made safe around outstanding tool/auth/confirmation obligations; and how summarizer selection and the final yielded event differ from the token-threshold path.

tasks.title: File-backed artifact loading
tasks.prompt: Trace `FileArtifactService.load_artifact(...)` from its async entrypoint through path resolution and payload reconstruction. Explain user-versus-session scoping and filename safety; version discovery and selection; all `None` outcomes; metadata parsing and canonical-URI fallback; and the exact conditions that produce a binary `Part` versus a text `Part`, including MIME type and display-name handling.
